Ren POS can take the ingredients of what you sell out of stock, using a recipe per dish."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Two kinds of items","key":"md_two_kinds_of_items","id":"two-kinds-of-items","name":"md_two_kinds_of_items","value":"# Two kinds of items

- **Kept in stock** (bottled drinks, desserts bought ready): a normal stock item. With **Update Stock** on the POS Profile, the sale takes it out of the warehouse, as ERPNext always does.
- **Made in the kitchen** (dishes, cocktails): not a stock item. Its **recipe** says what one portion uses, and the ingredients are taken out instead."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"The recipe","key":"md_the_recipe","id":"the-recipe","name":"md_the_recipe","value":"# The recipe

A recipe is an ERPNext **BOM** for one unit of the dish. Set it in the item editor (**Recipe**: add ingredients and their quantity per portion) or in the Desk (the Item's **Restaurant** tab → *Recipe (BOM)*; empty uses the item's default BOM). The editor shows the **cost per portion** from current costs.

- Options adjust it: *NO Tomato* takes the tomato out of that portion, *EXTRA Cheese* adds more, a chosen side adds its own recipe. The **Portion** of each option sets how much.
- A size without a recipe of its own uses the item's recipe.
- A combo without a recipe uses the recipes of its parts."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"When stock moves","key":"md_when_stock_moves","id":"when-stock-moves","name":"md_when_stock_moves","value":"# When stock moves

Not on every sale. When the cashier **closes the register**, the ingredients of every paid order of the shift leave stock in one **Stock Entry** (Material Issue) from the POS Profile's warehouse. Only POS Profiles with **Update Stock** on do this. A closing never fails because of stock; a problem is logged, and a daily job retries the pending ones."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Counting and variance","key":"md_counting_and_variance","id":"counting-and-variance","name":"md_counting_and_variance","value":"# Counting and variance

Count the real stock with **Stock Counts** (ERPNext Stock Reconciliation). The **Ingredient Usage Variance** report compares, per ingredient, what the recipes say was used with what really left the shelf between two counts: shrinkage, waste and portioning show up there."}}]}]
